indoor/chaise-longues/rafael.description_en: Chaise longue with a wood and metal frame. The padding is made of polyurethane foam. The upholstery, available in leathers or fabrics from the collection. An integrated marble side table, selected from the available range, can be added on the armrest.
materials: Integrated marble coffee table: oxyd green, dover white,
dimensions: DI RA/T - L 260 x D 172 x H 84

indoor/coffee-tables/bonsai.description_en: The Bonsai coffee table collection is distinguished by a structure with organic lines inspired by nature. The structure is entirely crafted in sculpted bronze and, starting from a single element, develops into various units supporting marble tops. These tops, also featuring rounded shapes, can be made in sculpted bronze, in the collection’s decorative finish, or with the marbles from the collection. Available in various sizes and heights.

indoor/coffee-tables/decoro.description_en: Coffee table is characterized by tops with a pronounced thickness, made in the collection’s decorative finish, from which it takes its name. The base is in dark lacquered wood. Available in various shapes and sizes.

indoor/coffee-tables/field.description_en: Coffee table with sharp geometries, characterized by a composition of metallic elements reminiscent of an aerial view of cultivated fields. Available with top in the collection’s decorative finish, bronzed brass, or satin steel. Available in different sizes.
materials: Top: decoro - bronzed brass - satin steel

indoor/coffee-tables/forest.description_en: Coffee table with metal structure, whose legs are the result of combining cylinders of different sizes, available in bronzed brass, gold-plated brass, or black chrome finishes. Tops available in different sizes, made in marble or with the collection’s decorative finish.
materials: Base:black chrome - bronzed brass - gold polished

indoor/coffee-tables/gatsby.description_en: Round coffee table characterized by the geometries of its base, whose structural elements intertwine in a play of diagonals. Made of metal with bronzed brass and black chrome finishes, it features a beveled-edge top in the decorative finish or in the marbles from the collection. Available in various sizes and heights.

indoor/coffee-tables/genesi.description_en: Round coffee table whose structure results from the extrusion of the base circle. Entirely made of flamed metal, it is lifted from the floor by a thin gold-plated brass plinth that gives it an airy and lightweight appearance. Available in various sizes and heights.

indoor/coffee-tables/globo.description_en: Side table characterized by the twist of its metal leg in bronzed brass and chrome finish. The round, beveled-edge top is available in various finishes: Category B leather, bronzed brass, decorative painted finish, and marbles from the collection. Available upon request with base in black chrome or satin brass finish.
materials: Top: leather - bronzed brass - decoro - marble
Base: chrome - bronzed brass - black chrome - brushed

indoor/coffee-tables/hugo.description_en: Coffee table characterized by a thick top, entirely upholstered in leather in either smooth or matelassé version. The top is made with marbles from the collection, while the metallic details of the frames and legs are in bronzed brass or chrome. Available in two sizes.

indoor/coffee-tables/incanto.description_en: Coffee table with soft and sinuous geometries, characterized by the overlapping of two tops: the first, lower one, obtained by sculpting a bronzed brass plate; the second made with marbles from the collection. Available in three sizes.

indoor/coffee-tables/incanto-wave.description_en: Coffee table with soft and sinuous geometries, characterized by the overlapping of two tops: the first, lower one, obtained by sculpting a bronzed brass plate; the second made with marbles from the collection.

indoor/coffee-tables/landmark.description_en: Collection of coffee tables with organic shapes, featuring a cylindrical base and outer perimeter of the top made in bronzed brass. The tops, with inlay work, can be crafted with marbles from the collection. Available in various sizes and heights.

indoor/coffee-tables/liberty.description_en: Coffee table characterized by a metal base available in bronzed brass, black chrome, and gold-plated brass finishes. Its grooved leg recalls Doric columns. The round, beveled- edge top is available in various finishes: Category B leather, ebony, bronzed brass, decorative painted finish, and marbles from the collection. Available in various heights and sizes.
materials: Base:black chrome - bronzed brass - gold polished

indoor/coffee-tables/lord.description_en: Round coffee table whose three compass-opening legs provide both support and elegance. Made of metal with bronzed brass and black chrome finishes. The beveled- edge top is available in various finishes: Category B leather, bronzed brass, decorative painted finish, and marbles from the collection. Available in various sizes and heights.

indoor/coffee-tables/monaco.description_en: Coffee table with irregular and rounded shapes, always unique. The base is made with a bronzed brass cylinder, the frame in sculpted bronze; the top is available in sculpted bronze, decorative painted finish, and marbles from the collection. Available in various shapes and heights.

indoor/coffee-tables/moon.description_en: Coffee table made with a cylindrical lower base and an upper section composed of two rotated and overlapping semicircles. The perimeter frame is made in bronzed brass; the lower and middle tops are upholstered in Category B leather, while the upper top can be made with marbles from the collection. Available in two sizes.

indoor/coffee-tables/noah.description_en: The Noah coffee table collection is characterized by tripod bases in a bronzed brass finish, supporting tops with flowing organic shapes. Available in various sizes and heights, the tops can be customized with artistic finishes from the Decoro series or with fine marbles from the collection.

indoor/coffee-tables/oblo.description_en: Side table made with a bent metal tubular structure in chrome finish. The top and base can be upholstered in Category B and C leather. Upon request, the structure can also be made in black chrome finish.
materials: Base: bronzed brass - chrome - black chrome

indoor/coffee-tables/opale.description_en: Round coffee table with base characterized by an asymmetrical leather-upholstered leg and one or more slender legs made of metal tubing, available in satin brass or bronzed brass finishes. The beveled-edge top is available in various finishes: Category B leather, bronzed brass, decorative painted finish, and marbles from the collection. Available in various sizes and heights.
materials: Base: bronzed brass - brushed brass - black chrome

indoor/coffee-tables/paride.description_en: Side table made from a single bent metal element, available in metal with enamel bronze and satin steel finish or entirely clad in Calacatta Oro marble or Guatemala marble.
materials: Structure: bronze finished metal - satin steel - marble

indoor/coffee-tables/rock.description_en: Coffee table whose top geometries reflect exactly what its name suggests: irregular shapes inspired by the mineral world. The metal base is made with thin bronzed brass blades. The top is available in decorative finishes and marbles from the collection.

indoor/coffee-tables/sixty.description_en: Coffee table with retro lines inspired by Art Nouveau. The three fluted metal legs, available in bronzed brass, satin brass, and black chrome finishes, frame the geometry of the top. The latter is available in decorative painted finishes and marbles from the collection. Also available in a tray-top version, in decorative painted finish and Category B leather. Available in various sizes and heights.
materials: Details: bronzed brass - brushed brass - black chrome

indoor/coffee-tables/sixty-trays.description_en: Coffee table with retro lines inspired by Art Nouveau. Available in various sizes and heights.
materials: Details: bronzed brass - brushed brass - black chrome

indoor/coffee-tables/space.description_en: Coffee table made with two overlapping circular tops that, thanks to an integrated mechanism, allow infinite configurations through rotation. The base, made of a metal cylinder, and the lateral profile of the top are available in brass and satin steel finishes. The top can be made in black or green back-painted glass, or with marbles from the collection. Upon request, the metal parts are available in bronzed brass. Available in two sizes.
materials: Top: black glass - green glass - marble
Details: brushed brass - satin steel - bronzed brass

indoor/coffee-tables/twist.description_en: Coffee table with a square base that, through rotation, transforms into a hexagonal top, creating a play of reflections, shadows, and chiaroscuro effects. The structure is made in bronzed brass; the top is available in various finishes: Category B leather, decorative painted finish, and marbles from the collection.

indoor/coffee-tables/vortex.description_en: A collection of coffee tables defined by an evocative vortex- shaped silhouette, available in two heights. The sculptural metal base is offered in a patinated bronze or pewter finish, topped with a selection of fine marbles from the collection.

indoor/coffee-tables/zoe.description_en: Coffee table with a sculptural structure created by the twisting of its base, made of metal with bronzed brass finish. The beveled-edge top is available in various finishes: Category B leather, decorative painted finish, and marbles from the collection. Available in two shapes and sizes.

indoor/consoles/absolute.description_en: Minimalist console featuring a metal structure available in patinated bronzed brass and enamel gold finishes or painted black chrome and steel. The top can be made in marble from the collection.
materials: Base: black chrome finished metal & steel -

indoor/consoles/dorotea.description_en: Console with a slim, elegant structure crafted in sculpted bronze. Available in various sizes and heights. Tops made in marble from the collection.

indoor/consoles/forest.description_en: Console with a metal structure available in bronzed brass or black chrome finishes. Tops come in various sizes, made in marble or with decorative finishes from the collection. An additional finish in gold-plated brass is available on request.

indoor/consoles/lauren.description_en: Console with a metal structure in bronzed brass or chrome finish. Externally upholstered in leather, available in quilted “matelassé” or smooth versions. indoor/consoles/pure.description_en: Console with a metal structure in bronzed brass and gold- plated brass finishes. Available in various sizes and heights. Tops made of satin-finished bronzed glass.

indoor/consoles/rea.description_en: Console featuring a sculptural structure created through a double twist, crafted in metal with a bronze finish. Tops are available in various sizes, made in marble or with decoro finishes from the collection.

indoor/consoles/rock.description_en: Console featuring an essential design, defined by a rigorous metal structure in a bronzed brass finish. The top is available in a wide selection of fine marbles from the collection.

indoor/consoles/wally.description_en: Console with a sculptural metal base in a patinated bronze finish. The top can be made in marble or with decoro finishes from the collection.

indoor/consoles/zoe.description_en: Console featuring a sculptural structure created by the twisted base, crafted in metal with a bronze finish. The top can be made in marble or with decoro finishes from the collection.

indoor/desks/chiba.description_en: Desk featuring a wooden structure entirely upholstered in leather and equipped with two drawer units. It can be completed with an additional glass top. Upholstery available in various leather categories from the collection.

indoor/desks/coline.description_en: Desk featuring a wooden structure entirely upholstered in leather and equipped with two drawer units. Upholstery available in various leather categories from the collection.

indoor/desks/emily.description_en: Desk featuring a wooden structure entirely upholstered in leather and configured with two drawer units. Upholstery available in various leather categories from the collection.

indoor/desks/president.description_en: Desk featuring a curved metal base in a patinated bronze finish. The desktop is made of marble, available in a selection of varieties from the collection.

indoor/desks/roma.description_en: Desk featuring a wooden structure entirely upholstered in leather and configured with a drawer unit. Metal base in a bronzed brass finish. Upholstery available in various leather categories from the collection.

indoor/lighting/bagutta.description_en: The Bagutta series of table and floor lamps features a metal structure with bronzed brass or chrome finish, a fabric lampshade, and a lamp body covered in leather, regenerated hide, or marbles from the collection. Available in various sizes.

indoor/lighting/bijoux-applique.description_en: Bijoux is a collection of lamps available in table, wall, and pendant versions, crafted in satin brass or satin steel. The overlapping of staggered elements, both horizontally and vertically, creates unique plays of light and reflections.

indoor/lighting/bijoux-ceiling.description_en: Bijoux is a collection of lamps available in table, wall, and pendant versions, crafted in satin brass or satin steel. The overlapping of staggered elements, both horizontally and vertically, creates unique plays of light and reflections.

indoor/lighting/bijoux-table.description_en: Bijoux is a collection of lamps available in table, wall, and pendant versions, crafted in satin brass or satin steel. The overlapping of staggered elements, both horizontally and vertically, creates unique plays of light and reflections.

indoor/lighting/collier.description_en: Collier is a pendant lamp with strong scenic impact, characterized by a chain made of bronzed brass rings in different sizes, connecting the spherical white blown-glass shade to the ceiling. Available as a single element or in cascading compositions with two or more adjacent elements for an even more dramatic effect.

indoor/lighting/duo.description_en: Duo is a wall lamp in satin brass. The lampshade is made of folded metal and consists of two equal and symmetrical parts concealing the 3000 K LED light source. The light is projected onto the rear surface, creating ever-changing reflections and colors. Available in two sizes.

indoor/lighting/eclipse.description_en: The Eclipse wall lamp collection is distinguished by the overlapping of concentric circular elements in bronzed brass, asymmetrically arranged. The 3000 K LED light source is positioned at the back: light reflects onto the metallic surface, enhancing its warmth and depth. Available in different sizes.

indoor/lighting/elios.description_en: Elios is a table lamp with a cylindrical base made of bronzed brass covered in leather. Fabric lampshade available.

indoor/lighting/fiona.description_en: Table lamp with a bronzed brass finish metal structure, externally upholstered in leather and embellished with perimeter stitching.

indoor/lighting/gatsby.description_en: Gatsby is a table and floor lamp characterized by the geometry of its base, whose structural elements intertwine in a play of diagonals. Made of metal with bronzed brass or black chrome finish, it is available with a fabric lampshade. Upon request, the structure can also be covered in regenerated leather.
materials: Structure: bronzed brass - black chrome - hide leather

indoor/lighting/halo-1.description_en: Halo is a collection of pendant, wall, and table lamps. It features a circular metal structure in bronzed brass with gold- plated brass rings. The wall and table versions include a cylindrical Carrara marble element with a gold-plated brass detail. The 3000 K LED light source is diffused through a satin plastic shade combined with gauze. Available in various sizes and configurations.

indoor/lighting/halo-2.description_en: Halo is a collection of pendant, wall, and table lamps. It features a circular metal structure in bronzed brass with gold- plated brass rings. indoor/lighting/leaf.description_en: Leaf is a wall lamp made from a folded metal sheet in antique brass. The light source is concealed within the fold and projected toward the glossy inner surface. Compositions with multiple elements allow for unique lighting effects. Available in two shapes.

indoor/lighting/liberty.description_en: Liberty is a collection of floor and table lamps characterized by a metal base available in bronzed brass, black chrome, and gold-plated brass finishes. The stem, with its grooves, recalls Doric columns. Available with white or black fabric lampshades, blown glass, or smoked glass.

indoor/lighting/liberty-soft.description_en: Liberty is a collection of floor and table lamps characterized by a metal base available in bronzed brass, black chrome, and gold-plated brass finishes. indoor/lighting/nina.description_en: Table lamp featuring a refined metal structure in a bronze enamel finish, entirely upholstered in leather and embellished with perimeter stitching. The design is completed by a lampshade in precious ivory-colored fabric.

indoor/lighting/solitario.description_en: Solitario is a ceiling-adjustable pendant lamp made with a circular metal structure in brushed aluminum and satin brass, which can be positioned horizontally or vertically. The 3000 K LED light source is screened by a satin plastic shade. Available in different sizes.

indoor/lighting/trilogy.description_en: Trilogy is a collection of ceiling-adjustable pendant lamps featuring a circular metal structure in brushed aluminum and satin brass. Multiple compositions are possible through the overlapping of rings with different diameters. Ideal for spaces with double or triple-height ceilings.

indoor/lighting/wanda.description_en: Wanda is a collection of table and floor lamps available in brushed brass or black chrome. It is distinguished by its chalice-shaped base and hat-like upper part that houses the light source. The downward indirect light enhances both the stem and the underlying surface. Offered in various sizes, including the rechargeable Wanda R version. The floor version also features a circular top with beveled edges in Calacatta Oro marble.

indoor/living-storage-units/atlanta.description_en: Clean and sophisticated storage unit, featuring a wooden structure and doors enhanced with painted decoro finishes available in the collection’s variants, with a base in bronzed brass or chrome finish. Interiors include shelves and drawers lacquered. Available in various sizes and heights. An internal LED light can be fitted on request.
materials: Structure and doors: polished lacquered + decoro

indoor/living-storage-units/blade.description_en: Storage unit with bold, sharply defined geometric lines that characterize its appearance, featuring a structure and doors in ebony wood or upholstered in leather with “elle” or “baguette” stitching. The plinth and details are made of metal in bronzed brass, chrome, or black chrome finishes. Interiors include lacquered shelves in matching colors. Available in various sizes and heights.
materials: Doors: leather with embroidery elle o baguette
Details: bronzed brass, chrome or black chrome

indoor/living-storage-units/blade-low.description_en: Storage unit with bold, sharply defined geometric lines that characterize its appearance, featuring a structure and doors in ebony wood or upholstered in leather with “elle” or “baguette” stitching. Details: bronzed brass, chrome or black chrome

indoor/living-storage-units/coquette2.description_en: Storage unit with soft, refined lines, featuring a structure and uprights in wood fully upholstered in leather, with bronzed brass details at the base and top. The outer perimeter of the shelf is defined by a dark ash wood edging. Interiors are lacquered in matching colors.

indoor/living-storage-units/frak.description_en: Storage unit distinguished by the design of its doors, where wood and smoked glass combine in a dynamic interplay of diagonals. The doors and structure are crafted in precious ebony wood, while the internal shelves and top are available in the marbles of the collection, with integrated LED lighting. The legs are in black-stained wood with bronzed brass details. Available in various sizes and heights.

indoor/living-storage-units/frak-bar.description_en: Storage unit distinguished by the design of its doors, where wood and smoked glass combine in a dynamic interplay of diagonals. indoor/living-storage-units/iolanda.description_en: Sideboard defined by a geometry characterized by a play of solids and voids, with structure and doors fully upholstered in leather with a herringbone stitch. The interior is lacquered in a matching color, while the exposed back panel is in glass with integrated LED lighting. The lower shelf of the open compartment is available in the marbles of the collection. The legs, made of bronzed brass blades, lift it off the ground and, by slotting in, also define the sides of the open compartment.

indoor/living-storage-units/iolanda-low.description_en: TV unit with a structure upholstered in leather, featuring doors finished with a herringbone stitch detail. The legs, made of bronzed brass blades, lift it off the ground. Interiors are lacquered in matching colors.

indoor/living-storage-units/iole.description_en: Display cabinet with glass doors and a bronzed brass frame, featuring a structure and interior upholstered in leather. The doors of the internal drawer unit are finished with a herringbone stitch, while the back panel is in glass with integrated LED lighting. The top surface of the drawer unit is available in the marbles of the collection. The legs, made of bronzed brass blades, lift it off the ground.

indoor/living-storage-units/iole-high.description_en: Display cabinet with glass doors and a bronzed brass frame, featuring a structure and interior upholstered in leather. The back panel is in glass with integrated LED lighting, and the internal shelves are also upholstered in leather. The legs, made of bronzed brass blades, lift it off the ground.

indoor/living-storage-units/mondrian.description_en: Sideboard with a geometric design characterized by a play of solids and voids. The structure and drawers are fully upholstered in leather. The top can be made using marbles from the collection, with metal inserts in bronzed brass.
materials: Details: bronzed brass or satin steel

indoor/living-storage-units/penelope.description_en: Storage unit with minimalist lines. The metal legs, made of bronzed brass, lift it off the ground. indoor/living-storage-units/penelope-low.description_en: Storage unit with minimalist lines, derived from the Penelope model, where the metal legs in bronzed brass are lower, in a plinth-like style. The doors and structure are upholstered in leather, while the top can be made using marbles from the collection. The interiors are lacquered to match. Available in various sizes.

indoor/living-storage-units/sidney.description_en: The Sidney collection represents the essence of versatility. The structure and top can be made of metal with chrome or bronzed brass finishes, or in category B leather. The doors are upholstered in leather from the collection, with the option of embroidered leather upon request. The interiors are lacquered to match.

indoor/living-storage-units/trace.description_en: Sideboard with unique lines, created by overlapping two elements: a structure available in metal with satin steel or bronzed brass finishes, and a storage unit with doors and structure fully upholstered in leather

materials: Box and drawers: marble or leather
Base: bronzed brass or satin steel

indoor/mirrors/bevel.description_en: A sculptural mirror defined by the layering of two volumes. It can be positioned both vertically and horizontally.

indoor/mirrors/boheme.description_en: The Boheme mirror features a double tubular frame upholstered in leather, complemented by gold-plated or bronze-finished brass accents. It is available in a variety of sizes, as either a round wall-mounted mirror or a rectangular floor-standing mirror.
materials: Details: gold polished brass - bronzed brass

indoor/mirrors/double-ring.description_en: The Double Ring mirror features a gold polished brass frame with LED backlighting. Available in two sizes.

indoor/mirrors/montecarlo.description_en: The Montecarlo mirror features a bronze-finished brass frame with a simple design and soft, curved lines, available in a variety of sizes.

indoor/mirrors/ofelia.description_en: The Ofelia mirror is a round mirror with a bronze-finished brass frame, accented with gold polished brass details.

indoor/mirrors/turandot.description_en: The Turandot mirror is a vertical mirror with an oval frame in bronze-finished or satin brass, featuring a rectangular central mirror and designed to be repeated in various compositions.

indoor/night-storage-units/beverly.description_en: Nightstand featuring a leather-upholstered wooden frame, supported by a metal base in a patinated bronze or black chrome glint finish. indoor/night-storage-units/boheme.description_en: This bedside table features a wooden structure upholstered in leather and equipped with two drawers. materials: Details: bronzed brass, gold finished brass

indoor/night-storage-units/boheme-como.description_en: Chest of drawers featuring a wooden frame entirely upholstered in leather and equipped with drawer units. materials: Details: bronzed brass, gold finished brass

indoor/night-storage-units/club.description_en: Nightstand featuring a wooden frame entirely upholstered in leather and equipped with a drawer unit.
